subject: Reliability incidents impacting Checkout — path to addendum and capacity
messages:
From: Sarah Ford <sarah.ford@forkline.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@forkline.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Latency spikes in EU checkout — logs attached, need SLA path for renewal

Markus,

Thanks for taking this. Over the past two weeks we've seen repeated latency spikes in the EU region (notably 2026-09-01 10:23 UTC and 2026-09-08 14:47 UTC) that caused timeouts on our checkout flow. I've attached a CSV with request traces and the short incident timeline (forkline_incidents_jul_logs.csv).

This has put our November renewal at risk — the execs want assurances on uptime and tail latency. Two asks:

- Can Redwood provide a written addendum (SLA upgrade) or a route to a premium tier that guarantees 99.95% availability for our throughput profile?
- In parallel, we need a remediation plan and a proposal for a dedicated pilot (pinned capacity) so we can expand usage without regressions.

We'll need to resolve commercial terms (credits/retainer) before the renewal conversation. Are you available for a 30-minute call this week? Prefer Thu 9–11am CET.

Thanks,
Sarah Ford
Director of Platform
Forkline Solutions

Attachments: forkline_incidents_jul_logs.csv

I'm available Thu 9:00–10:00 CET — let's lock that. Evelyn will be our CS lead for the pilot and contract coordination.

Best,

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: [Internal] Diagnostic notes and remediation options for Forkline

Markus / Evelyn — quick diagnostic notes after an initial pass on the traces Sarah sent.

Findings (high level):
- Pattern: long-tail latency correlated with periodic KV-cache evictions during peak bursts; memory pressure on certain GPU nodes triggered GC and increased token generation latency.
- Scope: ~0.6% of requests experiencing >2.5s tail latency during peak windows; aligns with their reported checkout timeouts.

Remediation options (recommended order):
A) Immediate: Increase prefix/KV cache retention window for Forkline traffic and enable conservative autoscale buffer (low-risk, quick config change).
B) Pilot: Dedicated pooled capacity with pinned model instance (reduces cross-tenant interference) + quantization profile tuned for their sequence lengths.
C) Long-term: Kernel-level optimization and tracing hook to reduce eviction-induced stalls (engineering work, 4–6 weeks).

Estimated commercial framing for pilot: 4-week pilot, dedicated nodes equivalent to 3x current baseline, cost uplift ~22% (with 6% one-time pilot setup). We can offer a 10% credit against the next quarter invoice if we miss the SLO during the pilot window.

Attaching a short diagnostic summary (diagnostic_summary.txt). I can present these options on the Thu call.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Reliability Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: diagnostic_summary.txt

2) Timeline: we need an executed addendum by the start of Oct to lock renewal decision.

If you can include the 12% credit clause in the proposed addendum and confirm the pilot cost estimate in writing, we'll proceed to a signature (via DocuSign). Thu 9 CET works for the call. Please send the updated commercial note prior to the meeting so our procurement team can review.

Thanks,
Sarah
